headlines.title: Euro underperforms against Japanese Yen amid Japan’s intervention fears
EXCLUSIVE: Japan top FX diplomat urges markets to heed 'very clear' warning on yen
Nikkei Falls After Briefly Topping 67,000 as Chip Rally Fades
Japan's Nikkei snaps five-day winning run on Micron earnings caution
Japan's Nikkei Stock Average Falls 486 Points, First Decline in Six Sessions on Profit-Taking
Japan shares lower at close of trade; Nikkei 225 down 0.69%
Japan and South Korea Stocks Weaken as Kospi Drops 2.7%, Samsung and SK Hynix Fall Over 5%, Kioxia Drops Over 4%

marketTone.ko: 일본 증시는 오늘 5거래일 연속 상승세를 마감하며 하락 전환했습니다. 차익 실현 매물과 반도체 업종 랠리 둔화, 마이크론 실적 경고 등이 니케이 지수 하락을 이끌었습니다. 한편, 엔화는 강세를 보였으며, 일본 외환 당국자는 시장에 "매우 분명한" 경고를 보내며 개입 가능성에 대한 우려를 키웠습니다.
marketTone.en: Japanese stocks experienced a downturn today, with the Nikkei 225 snapping a five-day winning streak and falling due to profit-taking and a fading rally in the chip sector. Concerns over Micron's earnings outlook contributed to weakness in semiconductor-related shares across the region. Meanwhile, the Japanese Yen strengthened, prompting Japan's top FX diplomat to issue a "very clear" warning to markets amid fears of potential intervention.
